boards.title: Your First Weekend at Holy Family University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A Friday-to-Sunday sequence for learning the Philadelphia campus, finding student resources, and trying documented all-ages activities.

cards.title: Start at the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · establish your campus base
cards.notes: Begin at the Campus Center, then use the official map to identify its student lounge, dining, recreation, and student-service spaces.
cards.short_summary: Use the building that concentrates everyday student amenities as your first navigation anchor.
cards.evidence_claim: Holy Family University's 2026 Philadelphia campus map identifies the Campus Center and lists its student lounge, Tiger Café, gymnasium, fitness center, esports, and student-service offices.
cards.access_notes: Consult the official campus map and follow posted building-access requirements.

cards.title: Locate Your Library Setup
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · find study tools before the weekend
cards.notes: Walk through during posted hours and locate the printers, computers, research help, and individual study rooms you may need later.
cards.short_summary: A practical reconnaissance stop for study technology, quiet rooms, and librarian support.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says its Philadelphia library provides librarians, Tiger Wi-Fi, computers, printers, individual study rooms, and academic resources.
cards.access_notes: Use only during the current posted schedule; hours vary by semester and the summer 2026 library is closed Saturday and Sunday.

cards.title: Find the Campus Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · add a visual landmark
cards.notes: Head to the Education and Technology Center’s lower level and check whether an exhibition is accessible during your visit.
cards.short_summary: Learn the location of the university gallery where students engage with exhibition work.
cards.evidence_claim: Holy Family University identifies its Art Gallery on the lower level of the Sister Francesca Onley Education and Technology Center and describes it as an exhibition space involving students.
cards.source_title: Discovering and Exploring Opportunities in Fine Art
cards.access_notes: No current public gallery hours are stated on the source page; check building access and exhibition availability before entering.

cards.title: Learn the Tiger Café Routine
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · understand the main dining option
cards.notes: Check the current menu and dietary options, then learn where meal swipes or à-la-carte purchases fit into your weekend plans.
cards.short_summary: Use dinner to understand the main campus dining hall and its meal-plan system.
cards.evidence_claim: Holy Family University identifies the Tiger Café in the Campus Center as its primary dining hall and posts weekday dinner and weekend brunch and dinner periods.
cards.access_notes: The posted schedule lists weekday dinner from 4:30–8 p.m.; weekend brunch from 10 a.m.–2 p.m. and dinner from 4–6 p.m.

cards.title: Request Esports Center Access
cards.subtitle: Friday night · set up an indoor social option
cards.notes: Submit the student access form before arriving, then confirm that free-use time does not conflict with a varsity practice or match.
cards.short_summary: Prepare for a late indoor gaming session in the university’s 20-PC esports space.
cards.evidence_claim: Holy Family University says all current students may use its 20-PC Esports Center during free hours after completing an access request.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 10 a.m.–midnight daily, but the room closes for varsity practices and matches; access requires prior confirmation.

cards.entity_name: Albert & Carolyn Smith Cardio Room and Weight Room
cards.title: Activate Fitness Center Entry
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · prepare a repeatable workout stop
cards.notes: Complete the online form in advance, bring appropriate shoes, and tour both the cardio and weight-training floors with a companion.
cards.short_summary: Set up access to the Campus Center’s two-level student fitness facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The university places the cardio and weight rooms in the Campus Center, describes their equipment, and requires an online form before swipe access is activated.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours are posted as 6 a.m.–midnight daily; allow up to five business days after submitting the required access form.

cards.title: Trace the Route to the Fieldhouse
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · learn the athletics edge of campus
cards.notes: Follow the official map to the athletic field and fieldhouse, noting the route and nearby parking without entering restricted team areas.
cards.short_summary: Turn a campus walk into useful wayfinding for future athletic events and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Holy Family University's 2026 Philadelphia campus map names and locates the Athletic Field & Metz Family Fieldhouse on campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor observation is the intended stop; follow posted facility rules and do not enter team or otherwise restricted areas.

cards.title: Walk the Glen Foerd Grounds
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · explore the nearby Delaware riverfront
cards.notes: Check the event calendar, then explore the rose garden, vineyard, old riverfront oaks, and QR-guided interpretation before dusk.
cards.short_summary: A documented free outing through an 18-acre historic riverfront landscape near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Glen Foerd states that its 18-acre grounds are a public park, free to visit, and include a rose garden, vineyard, and riverfront oaks.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are posted as open daily from 8 a.m. to dusk, but private events can restrict access; check the calendar before leaving.

cards.entity_name: Blessed Mary of Jesus the Good Shepherd Chapel
cards.title: Pause at the Delaney Hall Chapel
cards.subtitle: Sunday midday · choose reflection or weekday liturgy
cards.notes: Visit quietly for reflection if the building is accessible, or note the published weekday Mass time for a future campus routine.
cards.short_summary: Identify an inclusive campus reflection space and the university’s regular weekday liturgy location.
cards.evidence_claim: Holy Family University says weekday Mass is held in the Blessed Mary of Jesus the Good Shepherd Chapel in Delaney Hall and welcomes people of all faith traditions and those still searching.
cards.access_notes: Weekday Mass is posted for Monday–Friday, 1–1:30 p.m.; Sunday building access is not stated, so verify before visiting.

cards.title: Close with the Campus Labyrinth
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · finish with a quiet map landmark
cards.notes: Use the official map to find the named labyrinth, then take a calm final walk while reviewing the routes learned this weekend.
cards.short_summary: End the sequence at a distinctive campus landmark that reinforces your mental map.
cards.evidence_claim: Holy Family University's 2026 Philadelphia campus map identifies and locates a named Labyrinth on the main campus.
cards.access_notes: The map verifies the landmark but does not publish access hours; follow posted campus and grounds restrictions.
